overview: The Medford School Committee recognized student achievements in athletics, music, and marketing, and reviewed reports on enrollment, free and reduced lunch statistics, and the preliminary FY2019 state budget. The committee also approved a Community Preservation Act grant application for Roberts Elementary playground surfacing, approved revised field trip forms, and discussed the superintendent search process.

items.title: Routine Matters
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes from January 22, 2018, bill fund transfers, and payrolls.

items.title: Report of the Secretary
items.summary: Placed on file the secretary's report detailing weekly financial batch auditing procedures and budget coding reference charts.

items.title: Building and Grounds Subcommittee Report
items.summary: Accepted the subcommittee report recommending support for a Community Preservation Act grant application for Roberts Elementary playground resurfacing.

items.title: Rules Subcommittee Report
items.summary: Accepted the subcommittee report detailing revisions to district field trip approval forms and ongoing discussions regarding PTO and 501(c)(3) oversight guidelines.

items.title: Jingle Bell Road Race Donations
items.summary: Received presentation of over $31,000 in race proceeds distributed back to participating Medford schools and athletic teams.

items.title: MMEA Music Awards Recognition
items.summary: Recognized four high school students selected for the Massachusetts Music Educators Association Northeast District Festival, two of whom qualified for All-State Orchestra.

items.title: DECA Competition Achievements
items.summary: Recognized students from the vocational technical high school who qualified for state-level DECA marketing and entrepreneurship competitions.

items.title: Kindergarten Registration Report
items.summary: Placed on file an informational update announcing kindergarten registration dates and parent info sessions starting March 5, 2018.

items.title: Enrollment Update by Housing Complex
items.summary: Received an enrollment report analyzing school-age student counts residing in residential developments of 100 or more units.

items.title: Vocational School Enrollment Report
items.summary: Received a breakdown of vocational high school student enrollment by shop area and discussed potential future shop program adjustments.

items.title: Free and Reduced Lunch Applications Report
items.summary: Placed on file the free and reduced lunch statistics showing a 43.52% district participation rate, and requested comparative data on college fee waiver utilization.

items.title: FY2019 State Budget Update
items.summary: Referred to the Community Relations Subcommittee a report detailing initial FY2019 state budget estimates, Chapter 70 aid, and charter school assessment impacts.

items.title: Roberts Elementary CPA Grant Application
items.summary: Approved submitting a Community Preservation Act grant application to finance rubber tile resurfacing at the Roberts Elementary School playground.

items.title: Revised Field Trip Approval Forms
items.summary: Approved updated administrative field trip approval forms incorporating clarified approval sequences and ADA reference checklists.

items.title: Condolence Resolutions
items.summary: Passed resolutions expressing condolences to the families of Grace Perella, David Train, and Phyllis Bagnola.

items.title: Superintendent Search Process Update
items.summary: Discussed the upcoming superintendent search survey, search committee composition, focus group schedules, and selection timeline.
